summary: Tested the Hook -> Storyline -> Reward feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_storylines.py with 10 pytest cases (10/10 PASS) covering: starting_scene.hooks backfill (3 hooks, valid spans + verb_hints), draft endpoint returning 3-5 beats with total_dc and a linked quest KnowledgeCard (storyline tag + storyline_id), list/get endpoints, sequential resolve advancing current_beat each call, final-beat completion returning a themed reward whose XP equals min(1200, round(max(60, total_dc*8)/25)*25), abandon flipping status to 'abandoned' (and 404 on second call), Lean DM /dm/action engagement detection (positive case 'I follow the scuff marks' returns engaged_hook_id + active 3-5 beat storyline payload, negative case 'I rest in the room' returns null), and DM hook-metadata persistence on new narration. Frontend (Playwright on the public URL): loaded latest campaign, asserted 3 inline hook spans ([data-hook-id]) for the existing campaign with the 'Three things draw the eye:' opener; clicking a hook opens [data-testid=hook-hint-popover] with the verb hint and 'Type something like' tip; Dismiss closes it; the ActiveInvestigationPanel renders at top with storyline-title 'Scuff Marks and Secrets', Roll d20 / Pass / Fail / Abandon buttons; clicking Pass through to the last beat (5 beats) triggered StorylineRewardModal showing '+ 550 XP', tone chip 'satisfaction', themed item 'Sealed Letter from the Benefactor', and a closing description. World-map graph regression still passes (graph + 6 region nodes mount, accept-event 'Quest active' badges still rendered).

minor.issue: Hook-engagement detector occasionally over-matches benign actions (e.g. 'I rest in the room and wait quietly.' once returned engaged_hook_id != null on the first run, drafting a storyline the player never asked for; passed on a re-run because the previous-turn hook set rotates). Detector should be tightened (e.g. require a verb-hint match in addition to the topic word, or skip detection when the action is a passive idle phrase like 'rest', 'wait', 'stand still').

issues: Beat-dot rail is rendered visually but the dots have no data-testid (e.g. `beat-dot-{i}`). Same for the beat-counter ('Beat 1 of 5') and the check-type/DC chip ('Investigation DC 12'). Add data-testid='beat-counter', data-testid='check-chip', and data-testid='beat-dot-{i}' to make these robustly testable. Currently only [storyline-title, storyline-beat-text, storyline-roll-btn, storyline-pass-btn, storyline-fail-btn, storyline-abandon-btn] are exposed.

action_items: (Minor) Tighten engagement detector in services/hook_extractor.py::detect_engaged_hook to avoid drafting storylines from passive/idle phrases ('rest', 'wait', 'sleep') and require co-occurrence of verb_hint cue, not just topic word.
(Minor) Add data-testid attributes for beat-dot-{i}, beat-counter, and check-chip inside ActiveInvestigationPanel for downstream test stability.

(Cosmetic) The reward modal's storyline-reward-modal node lacks an explicit reward-xp data-testid wrapper around the '+ 550 XP' text — selector worked because of the literal string, but a stable data-testid is preferable.
critical_code_review_comments: storyline_service.draft_storyline correctly enforces 3..5 beats and clamps DC 8..20, but on JSON-decode failure it silently falls back to the 4-beat template — total_dc then has no relation to the hook's narrative weight. Consider logging a metric or returning a 'fallback' flag the UI can show.

routers/storylines.resolve_storyline_beat updates the linked quest card description on each beat advance, but if the quest card was deleted by a player it silently no-ops. Acceptable but worth a comment.

routers/storylines.draft_storyline_endpoint inserts the storyline doc with its own `id` field. Good — list/get queries match on `id`. However insert_one mutates the dict by adding `_id`; the route already returns via storyline_to_dict which strips _id, so transport is clean.

services/storyline_service.advance_storyline mutates the input dict in place AND returns it; safe here because router controls the only reference, but a defensive copy would be safer if this util is reused.

Reward XP cap of 1200 is generous for a single 5-beat investigation at character level 1-3; consider scaling cap with character level, otherwise a single completion can outweigh 2-3 sessions of normal play.

Engagement detection prompt+regex (hook_extractor.detect_engaged_hook) runs on EVERY player action including pure dialogue ('I say hello'). On 'I rest in the room.' it triggered once — recommend short-circuit when action is < 4 tokens or matches a stoplist of idle verbs.

ActiveInvestigationPanel renders Roll/Pass/Fail/Abandon together — Pass and Fail both immediately advance the beat. Consider making 'Roll d20' the primary action and Pass/Fail debug/manual-override (currently it's easy to skip the dice entirely, which undermines the DC system).

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest cases pass; one negative-case test flaky on first run due to over-matching engagement detector — flagged as minor backend issue)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on asserted selectors: 3 hook spans, hook-hint-popover open+dismiss, ActiveInvestigationPanel mounts with storyline title and Pass button, 6 Pass clicks drive the storyline to completion and open StorylineRewardModal with +550 XP / themed item / tone chip; World Map regression (graph + 6 region nodes) intact

test_credentials: None required — uses the seeded campaign id a19b5ff2-e859-4cef-9019-b36e2dbfdd39 and character id 69f2985e0999201c3edfaa3a directly per the review request.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert two TEST_-prefixed storylines (and their linked quest cards) on the existing campaign during the run: one 3-5 beat storyline that gets fully resolved (status=completed, reward populated) and one that gets abandoned (status=abandoned, quest card status=failed). The previously seeded 'Scuff Marks and Secrets' active storyline created by the smoke-test was completed during the frontend Playwright run via 6 Pass clicks. Main agent should be aware: the existing campaign now has these resolved/abandoned storyline docs in campaign_storylines and corresponding cards in campaign_cards. They do not block re-running the suite.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_storylines.py are reusable; they rely on the seeded campaign id (a19b5ff2-e859-4cef-9019-b36e2dbfdd39) and character id (69f2985e0999201c3edfaa3a). If those are wiped, update the constants at the top of the file. Frontend data-testids in use for this feature: load-latest-campaign (button text fallback works), [data-hook-id] (HookSpan), hook-hint-popover, active-investigation-panel, storyline-title, storyline-beat-text, storyline-roll-btn, storyline-pass-btn, storyline-fail-btn, storyline-abandon-btn, storyline-reward-modal. Beat dots, beat-counter, and check/DC chip do NOT have testids yet. Reward XP follows: min(1200, round(max(60, total_dc*8)/25)*25). The engagement-detection negative test ('I rest in the room') is mildly flaky (~1 in 5 runs the LLM over-engages) — re-run if it fails once.
rca of the issue: Negative-case engagement test failure (transient): the lean_dm endpoint loads active_hooks from the previous DM message OR campaign.starting_scene.hooks. The detect_engaged_hook regex+LLM combo treats any token overlap with a hook topic word as engagement; a passive action like 'I rest in the room.' contains 'room' which can substring-match an existing hook topic ('the room', 'the doorframe'), drafting an unwanted storyline. Mitigation: short-circuit in detect_engaged_hook when the action token length < 4 or starts with idle verbs (rest|wait|sleep|stand|sit|breathe), and require co-occurrence of the hook's verb_hint synonym set.
